gaps.sentence: They're ___ (HOPE) that the talks will resume.
gaps.explanation: 'Be hopeful that…' = feeling hope; 'hopefully' is the adverb.

gaps.sentence: The report was highly ___ (CRITICISE) of the ministry.
gaps.explanation: 'Be critical of' — adjective; 'criticism' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: The committee reached its verdict after lengthy ___ (DELIBERATE).
gaps.explanation: 'After lengthy deliberation' — the noun for careful discussion.

gaps.sentence: The report was highly ___ (CRITIC) of the new scheme.
gaps.explanation: 'Highly critical of' — the adjective describing a judgement.
'Arrived damaged' — participle describing the state of the parcel.
The journey causes tiredness: tiring. 'Tiresome' means annoying.

gaps.sentence: A side-by-side ___ (COMPARE) of the two plans reveals clear differences.
gaps.explanation: 'A comparison of X and Y' — the noun form follows the article and adjective.

gaps.sentence: The company needs to ___ (MODERN) its factories.
